input_role: consumed development matrix; never independent holdout evidence
motivation: The global additive model failed because one coefficient vector was shared across four physically different result shapes. Failure was concentrated in the three-way mask_output family.

model.convergence_rule: Every ridge view must converge; nonconverged views cannot be silently dropped.
model.override_rule: Override the stable legal fallback only when every ridge view selects the same candidate outside the practical tie band.
model.support_rule: If any candidate feature leaves its per-candidate training minimum/maximum envelope, fail closed to the stable legal fallback.

validation.candidate_legality: Only result-equivalent legal candidates from the completed audit may be ranked.

decision_rule.pass: Freeze the shape-aware model design, then create a new unseen scenario matrix before any paper claim.
decision_rule.fail: Retain the complete negative result and do not tune this consumed matrix into a fresh evaluation.

not_authorized: changing fallbacks or thresholds after reading this result
